advisory.finding: The newly-added finalize.py deps filter excludes glob-form fetch targets via `"*" not in target`, but no test asserts that a glob target (e.g. `infra/*.tf`) is kept OUT of verdict['deps']. AC6 only asserts concrete files (`infra/main.tf`, `infra/variables.tf`) are present via subset checks, which stay green regardless of whether the glob exclusion fires — so a regression removing the `"*" not in target` guard (letting a glob target reach reviewed_file_hashes) is undetectable.
scenarios: A refactor drops the `"*" not in target` clause; glob targets pollute the signed dep set and the region-gated novelty floor comparison, with no failing test
